subject: Request: temporary rotational exemption + delegated on-call for overnight P1s
messages:
From: Aisha Sayeed <aisha@fastcommerce.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: FastCommerce Ops <ops@fastcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: overnight P1 coverage gap for Friday maintenance window

Hi Nikhil,

We have a planned database maintenance window for Friday 11pm-2am PT. Our team noticed the current P1 on-call schedule shows no Redwood dedicated responder during that timeframe (regional on-call is in APAC). For a customer-facing incident during that maintenance window we need clarity on who will respond and what the escalation path is.

Can Redwood confirm on-call coverage or provide an exception path where FastCommerce can trigger an emergency contact? We’d like confirmation by EOD Thu.

Attaching brief logs from earlier flapped connections.

Thanks,
Aisha
---
Aisha Sayeed
Head of Ops, FastCommerce
ops@fastcommerce.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Sayeed <aisha@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: overnight P1 coverage gap for Friday maintenance window

Thanks Aisha — and sorry for the late notice. I pulled the rota and you're right: our primary SRE responders are scheduled in EMEA/APAC and won't be online in the 11pm-2am PT window.

Proposed immediate options (short-term):
- Option A: Standby delegation — Redwood assigns a single senior on-call (rotated from our west-coast volunteers) to be on standby for FastCommerce for this maintenance window. Response SLA would be 30 minutes P1, 60 minutes P2.
- Option B: Delegated escalation contact — No assigned responder, but provide FastCommerce with the Redwood emergency escalation contact (senior on-call phone + Slack) to trigger manual wake-up; SLA best-effort.
- Option C: Accept an exception to the contracted 15-minute P1 overnight SLA for the Friday window (we log the event and provide credit if incidents occur).

I’ve attached a quick draft runbook and a provisional rotational matrix. Marcus and Mina — can you confirm headcount to staff Option A if FastCommerce prefers that? If not, I need approval from Laura to proceed with Option B or C.

Next step: Aisha, please let me know which option you prefer. If you choose A, we’ll send a confirmation of the assigned contact by 7pm Thu.

Regards,
Nikhil

Attachments: support_logs_20260526.zip, delegation_runbook_draft.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: overnight P1 coverage gap for Friday maintenance window

Nikhil — we can staff Option A for this one night, but will need to rotate the volunteer load fairly. I attached a short rotational_exemption_matrix.xlsx with volunteers and blackout dates. Two caveats:
1) We need explicit delegation (written confirmation) from the customer that the delegated responder is authorized to open/remediate incidents on their behalf.
2) For any on-call wake-ups outside normal hours we must track M-F counts for fatigue monitoring and may limit frequency to avoid burnout.

If Aisha agrees, I can assign Aaron (west-coast) to standby and provide his escalation contact.

—Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: overnight P1 coverage gap for Friday maintenance window

Thanks for the triage. Approve Option A for this single maintenance window (Friday 11pm-2am PT) subject to the following:
- Customer signs the delegation acknowledgement (I’ve drafted the short paragraph below).
- Incident review required within 48 hours and compensation considered if the incident is Redwood's service fault.
- Limit to 2 such standbys per calendar quarter per account without additional compensation.

Nikhil — please send the drafted acknowledgement to Aisha and confirm the named standby (Aaron). Include Marcus's caveats about fatigue policy in the ops note.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Sayeed <aisha@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: overnight P1 coverage gap for Friday maintenance window

Hi Aisha — thanks for your patience. Per internal approval we can provide Option A (standby delegation) for the upcoming Friday 11pm–2am PT window.

Summary of agreed terms (please reply to confirm):
- Redwood will assign Aaron (Senior SRE) as on-call standby for FastCommerce for the window: 2026-05-29 23:00–2026-05-30 02:00 PT.
- Response targets during this window: P1 — 30 minutes; P2 — 60 minutes.
- FastCommerce will provide written delegation acknowledging Redwood's agent may open remediation actions on behalf of FastCommerce if triggered.
- Redwood will log any incident and perform a 48-hour post-incident review; credits apply per standard SLA amendment if fault is on Redwood.
- This standby counts toward our quarterly voluntary standby cap (max 2 per quarter) and is a one-off exception unless a contract amendment is requested.

Attachment: delegation_acknowledgement_template.txt (please sign and return)

If Aisha confirms, Marcus will send Aaron's direct contact and the small runbook for the standby.

Best,
Nikhil
summary: Customer flagged a Friday overnight maintenance window with no Redwood responder scheduled. Nikhil triaged and proposed three options; Marcus confirmed capacity to staff a one-night standby. Laura approved Option A with conditions (delegation acknowledgement, post-incident review, quarterly cap). Final message asks customer to confirm and return the signed delegation acknowledgement. Attachments include logs, rotation matrix, and a draft runbook.
significance: temporary-sla-exception; one-night standby; delegated remediation authority required
file_notes: Template delegation acknowledgement saved to shared Drive; operations to add standby event to on-call calendar and tag for fatigue metrics.
